expert_text: In applied computing, training refers to the process of updating a machine learning model's parameters to improve its performance on a specific task by exposing it to a large dataset and adjusting its weights and biases accordingly. expert_text: In Applied computing, coverage refers to the extent to which a test suite or a set of test cases exercises the code or system being tested, ensuring that all possible scenarios and paths are executed. expert_text: In Applied computing, coverage refers to the extent to which a test suite or a set of test cases exercises the code or system being tested.
